summary.text: Gabe Woolley is a Republican state representative from Oklahoma House District 98 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Cathy Smythe as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Woolley was born in Jackson, Michigan, and has worked as an educator.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma Wesleyan University in 2020.
Woolley assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Dean Davis, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Government Oversight Committee.
